title: modernize-presubmit-and-lightweight-release-cleanup
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: presubmit pipelines had grown fragmented (multiple lint runners, duplicate build steps, and a brittle release smoke job). This PR consolidates the presubmit lint shards into a single lightweight adapter, extracts common bootstrapping to a small Go helper to improve hermetic behavior, and replaces the flaky release smoke script with a deterministic smoke probe that runs as an optional staged job. Summary of changes: 1) Add .github/actions/lint-adapter composite action that routes TypeScript, Python, and go linting into a single invocation with change-aware sharding; 2) Replace legacy .github/workflows/presubmit-*.yml files with a unified .github/workflows/presubmit.yml that exposes fast and full lanes; 3) Introduce tools/ci-bootstrap/main.go (small binary used by CI to set up toolchain leases and cache keys) and a cloud-friendly cache eviction helper scripts/ci-cache-cleanup.go; 4) Replace scripts/release-smoke.sh with scripts/release-smoke-probe (idempotent probe that queries staging endpoints and validates manifests); 5) Update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md with presubmit expectations and local-fastpath guidance. Checklist: [x] single-pass lint adapter implemented [x] presubmit workflow migrated and tested in canary [x] cache key semantics improved and recorded [x] release smoke probe added and tested [x] docs updated. Risk notes: this refactor touches CI primitives; rollout used canary on a small set of active PRs, and the new action includes a compatibility shim that falls back to legacy lint scripts for repos not yet migrated. See linked Linear ENG-4821 for rollout plan and rollback criteria. CI/observability: added a small telemetry ping (opt-in for internal runs) to aid debug when presubmit-timeouts occur. Migration notes: repository maintainers should move language-specific lint configs under .github/lint-configs/ to opt into the unified adapter. For any regressions, revert is possible by switching the workflow back to the previous presubmit-legacy workflow ref:refs/heads/presubmit-legacy. Related: updates touch some shared SDK packages; a follow-up will pin devdeps for all SDKs (ENG-4980).

Leo Chen: Observability: please add a presubmit-run tag to telemetry so we can correlate flakes with shard assignments.
